summary: Vivos Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing twelve August 31, 2026 exchange agreements with Streeterville Capital partitioning $2,861,270 of principal under an existing secured promissory note into twelve partitioned notes, each surrendered for common stock at an average $0.25 per share, up to 11,445,080 shares, exempt under Section 3(a)(9). This continues a pattern of debt-for-equity swaps, including prior August 4, 2026 exchanges. The transaction reduces debt but adds share overhang, with pricing at or above the Nasdaq Minimum Price. Watch for dilution pressure and Nasdaq compliance risk as the note balance declines.
